scope: Public non-mutating source-correlation helper for a bounded AC1024 fixed DICTIONARY profile with no EED, reactors, extension dictionary or data storage; raw frame size at most 4 MiB.
implementation: DRW_Dictionary::matchesAc1024DwgFrame reparses the retained object bytes with the existing DWG parser and AC1024 text codec, matches common fields, ordered name/handle/role entries, cloning/hard-owner values, exact frame publication identity and source location, and complete dictionary membership. It refuses decode issues, incomplete or incompatible metadata, unmodeled dependencies and exceptions. LIBDXFRW_HAS_AC1024_DICTIONARY_SOURCE_VERIFY advertises this additive nonvirtual method.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.4.44 and 20.4.93 were consulted; no parseDwg body was changed.
validation: Three physical named-block dictionaries 22D3, 21CD and 2120 match their typed callbacks, raw frames, frame publications and dictionary memberships.

Focused tests refuse changed typed owner, cloning and entry, raw type/truncation/version/storage/extension/common evidence, oversized frame, changed publication location/carrier, incomplete or changed membership and mismatched ordinal; each original source remains usable.
194 calibrated single-allocation failures across the three physical records refuse safely and pass immediate retry.
Focused dictionary, AC1024 layer binding and plot-style graph CTests passed; the final strengthened dictionary test and LC3 compatibility target also passed under -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror.

Source-release inventory passed with 1208 files. Frozen CTest inventory increased from 1372 to 1373 with exactly libdxfrw_dwg_ac1024_dictionary_source_verify added; native contract/self-test and the 720-input qualification digest passed.
limits: This helper correlates caller-supplied data using the existing parser; it does not authenticate source origin, check the enclosing frame CRC, prove unknown fields or unrelated references, establish graph/output closure, or qualify native semantics. It is not yet connected to LibreCAD export and does not promote a support claim or phase gate.
